integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, realistic e-commerce product video with warm soft indoor lighting and shallow depth of field. A medium shot frames a gentle young woman aged 25 to 30, wearing light makeup, long wavy hair, and an off-white knit cardigan, sitting in a warmly lit children's room. She holds up the hardcover board book "小熊的月亮船" with both hands, the cover facing the camera and matching exactly the book shown in <Picture 1>: a light blue-green night sky, a brown bear wearing a red scarf sitting in a crescent-shaped yellow moon boat holding a wooden oar, a small lit lantern hanging at the bow, surrounded by golden stars and mint-green clouds, with the title "小熊的月亮船" clearly visible on the upper cover and "童心出版社" at the bottom. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward the book cover as she smiles warmly, then gently opens the board book with both hands, revealing thick cardboard pages, rounded corners, and hand-painted watercolor illustrations of the bear on the moon boat. Her hands move naturally, the book stays undistorted, and all cover text remains sharp and legible. A warm, gentle female narrator (S1) says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[Chinese] 宝宝睡前总兴奋？读《小熊的月亮船》。</d> while the on-screen woman's lips remain closed and do not match the voiceover.

[Shot 2] At 00:04.500, the shot dissolves softly to a nighttime scene in the same children's room. A warm yellow desk lamp glows on the bedside table. The same woman sits beside the bed, with a 3-to-5-year-old toddler in pajamas leaning against her chest. She holds the open "小熊的月亮船" board book, pointing gently at the pages with one finger while murmuring softly to the child; the child reaches out a small finger to point at the golden stars and the moon boat illustration on the page. The room is quiet, warm, and healing, with shallow depth of field blurring the background toys. The narrator (S1) continues in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[Chinese] 小熊坐月亮船，慢慢说晚安。圆角厚纸板，环保油墨，两至六岁放心读。</d> while the woman on screen keeps murmuring softly to the child and her lip movements do not synchronize with the voiceover.

[Shot 3] At 00:10.500, the camera cuts back to the woman, now closing the "小熊的月亮船" book with both hands and looking at the camera with a warm, recommending smile. She places the book flat on a light wood table; beside it are stacked other picture books from the same series and a small gift box. The camera pulls out with small amplitude at slow speed, gradually framing the book, the stack of books, and the gift box in the lower-center of the frame, leaving clean empty space above for selling-point subtitles. The narrator (S1) says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[Chinese] 今晚，陪他坐上月亮船。点下方带回家。</d> while the on-screen woman's lips remain closed. The book cover, character design, color palette, page format, and title position stay consistent with <Picture 1> throughout, with no distorted hands, no deformed book, and no garbled text.

overall_soundscape: Warm indoor room tone hums softly throughout. The soft rustle of thick cardboard pages turning and the gentle tap of the book closing on the wooden table are heard clearly. A toddler breathes softly in the quiet bedtime scene, with faint fabric rustle as the child shifts against the woman.

non_diegetic_music: A gentle lullaby on soft music-box bells and warm piano notes at a slow tempo, with a sustained warm string pad underneath, fading out softly at the end.
